visual_elements.description: Positional-encoder vector structure, read left to right as four vertical stacks. (1) Rounded box, maroon border, white fill, two red lines: "sin(ωt)" and "cos(ωt)" (the general pair). Below it a green rectangle: "Sin/Cos pairs Vector Represents Position "t"" (Sin/Cos pairs bold; Position bold with red t) and "Any "ω" is accepted" (ω red). (2) Column of small green rounded boxes labeled Vector Pairs "K" containing black bold values top to bottom: 0, 1, 2, then vertical ellipsis dots, K, ellipsis dots, [d/2]-1. (3) Cream vertical strip labeled Index "i" with red values top to bottom: "i", 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, (blank gap), 2k, 2k+1, (blank gap), d-1-1, d-1. (4) Column of five rounded pair-boxes, each holding two stacked lines, alternating fill green/orange: green[sin(ω₀t), cos(ω₀t)], orange[sin(ω₁t), cos(ω₁t)], green[Sin(ω₂t), cos(ω₂t)] — capital S verbatim, orange[sin(ωₖt), cos(ωₖt)], green[sin(ω_{d/2}t), cos(ω_{d/2}t)]; small gaps/faint ellipsis dots between boxes; red text "dx1" at the column's bottom-right indicating output dimension.

Definitions box: cream fill, thin red border, six lines with color runs — line1 "Word Embedding Dimension "d" [Even Num]" (label red, d blue, [Even Num] green italic); line2 "Position Encoding Dimension "d"" (Position red, d blue, rest black); line3 "Number of Vector Pairs "K"=d/2  [0, 1, 2, ... d/2-1]" (label purple, K blue, rest black); line4 "Elements Index "i"   [0, 1, 2, ..., d-1]" (label blue, i red, range black); line5 "Even Index "i" is Sine Term ,   i=2*k" (Even Index blue, i red, Sine Term green, i=2*k red); line6 "Odd  Index "i" is Cosine Term,  i=2*k+1" (Odd Index blue, i red, Cosine Term green, i=2*k+1 red).

Example box: cream fill, thin red border. "Example:" red italic underlined; "d=100" black; "K=[0 ..49]" (K= blue, range black); "i=[0 .. 99]" (i= red, range black); "Sin [0,2,4,...]" (Sin green); "Cos [1,3,5,...]" (Cos green).

ω-selection box: light-blue fill, blue border. Lines: "Use different "ω" values for different "Pairs"" and "Select "ω" Value Based on "Pair" index "k"" (black text; ω, Pairs, Pair, k in red). White rounded sub-box with red border at right containing the equation ω_K = 1/10,000^{2k/d} — ω large red with blue subscript K, black fraction bar, numerator 1, denominator 10,000 with red superscript 2k/d. Below: "Largest  "ω" value = 1" (Largest blue bold, ω red) with "(Used in First Pair)" black to its right; "Smallest  "ω" value ≈  1/10000" (Smallest blue bold, ω red) with "(Used in Last Pair)" black; "Note:" blue italic underlined; "ω" Value depends on Embedding Dimension "d" ONLY (ω and d red); "ω" Value does NOT depend on Sequence Length (ω red, NOT bold).
Slide-number badge: small yellow circle with thin dark outline containing "33" in black, top-right corner.
Thin dark-red rectangular frame (no fill) inset around the entire slide content.

imagery: No photographs, icons, or illustrations on the slide. Only artifact: a black mouse-arrow cursor captured near the sin(ωₖt)/cos(ωₖt) box (video overlay, not slide content), and a black horizontal strip along the very bottom edge which is the video player progress bar, not slide content.
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title ~26-28pt bold red; subtitle ~20pt bold blue; body 12-16pt regular. Color-coded runs appear on all 6 definition lines, both ω-selection lines, both ω-dependence note lines, and all 5 example lines: red for ω/i/formulas, blue for K/d/Even-Odd labels, green for Sine/Cosine terms, purple for the 'Number of Vector Pairs' label. Italics on 'Example:', 'Note:', '[Even Num]'. Bold on 'Sin/Cos pairs', 'Position', 'Largest', 'Smallest', 'NOT'. Literal double quotes wrap variables ("d", "K", "i", "ω", "Pairs", "Pair", "t"). No bullet glyphs — lines are plain colored text; diagram numbers are centered in small rounded boxes.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — no partial bullet reveal. A black mouse cursor (video artifact) sits near the K-th sin/cos pair; black bar at very bottom is the video scrubber, not slide content.
recreation_brief: 1. Canvas: 16:9 slide, background #F2F2F2. 2. Frame: no-fill rectangle with ~2pt #990000 outline, inset ~5% from every edge. 3. Title: centered text box at x 25-75%, y 5-12% — "Sin/Cos Positional Encoder", Arial bold 28pt, #C00000. 4. Subtitle: centered text box at x 12-88%, y 12-17% — "Positional Vector with Same dimension as Embedding dimension", Arial bold 20pt, #0000CC. 5. Slide-number badge: ~0.45" oval at x 88-94%, y 10-17%, fill #FFD966, thin dark outline, black bold "33" centered. 6. General pair box: rounded rectangle at x 10-20%, y 23-38%, white fill, 2.5pt #8B0000 border, drop shadow; two centered 16pt lines in #C00000: "sin(ωt)" above "cos(ωt)". 7. Sin/Cos info box: rectangle at x 7-23%, y 42-60%, fill #D6E8CE, 1.5pt #00B050 border, ~12pt lines: "Sin/Cos pairs" (bold black), "Vector Represents" (black), "Position "t"" ("Position" bold black, "t" red bold), blank line, "Any "ω" is accepted" (black with "ω" red). 8. Vector Pairs label: #0000CC 12pt, two stacked lines "Vector" / "Pairs "K"", centered at x 22-27%, y 20-22%. 9. Vector Pairs column: five rounded boxes (fill #C6E0B4, 1pt #00B050 border) stacked at x 22-27%, y 22-93%, black bold ~12pt centered values in order 0, 1, 2, K, [d/2]-1, with plain-text vertical-ellipsis "..." rows between 2 and K and between K and [d/2]-1. 10. Index label: #C00000 12pt "Index "i"", centered at x 27-32%, y 20-22%. 11. Index column: tall rectangle at x 27-32%, y 22-94%, fill #FFF2CC, thin #C00000 outline; #C00000 centered values (~12pt) top-to-bottom: "i", 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, (blank gap), 2k, 2k+1, (blank gap), d-1-1, d-1. 12. Sin/Cos terms column at x 33-43%, y 21-95%: five rounded two-line boxes (~14pt) separated by narrow gaps with faint ellipsis dots, alternating green/orange — box 1 green (fill #C6E0B4, border #00B050, text #00B050): "sin(ω₀t)" / "cos(ω₀t)"; box 2 orange (fill #F8CBAD, border #ED7D31, text #ED7D31): "sin(ω₁t)" / "cos(ω₁t)"; box 3 green: "Sin(ω₂t)" / "cos(ω₂t)" (capital S verbatim); box 4 orange: "sin(ωₖt)" / "cos(ωₖt)"; box 5 green: "sin(ω_{d/2}t)" / "cos(ω_{d/2}t)". 13. Output-dimension tag: #C00000 text "dx1" at the bottom-right corner of the sin/cos column (near x 43%, y 95%). 14. Definitions box: rectangle at x 45-80%, y 18-55%, fill #FFF2CC, 1.5pt #C00000 border, 14pt, six lines with exact color runs: (1) "Word Embedding Dimension "d" [Even Num]" — label #C00000, "d" #0000CC, "[Even Num]" #00B050 italic; (2) "Position Encoding Dimension "d"" — "Position" #C00000, "d" #0000CC, rest black; (3) "Number of Vector Pairs "K"=d/2  [0, 1, 2, ... d/2-1]" — label #7030A0, "K" #0000CC, rest black; (4) "Elements Index "i"   [0, 1, 2, ..., d-1]" — label #0000CC, "i" #C00000, range black; (5) "Even Index "i" is Sine Term ,   i=2*k" — "Even Index" #0000CC, "i" #C00000, "Sine Term" #00B050, "i=2*k" #C00000; (6) "Odd  Index "i" is Cosine Term,  i=2*k+1" — "Odd Index" #0000CC, "i" #C00000, "Cosine Term" #00B050, "i=2*k+1" #C00000. 15. Example box: rectangle at x 81-93%, y 18-55%, fill #FFF2CC, 1.5pt #C00000 border, ~12pt lines: "Example:" (#C00000 italic underlined), "d=100" (black), "K=[0 ..49]" ("K=" #0000CC, range black), "i=[0 .. 99]" ("i=" #C00000, range black), "Sin [0,2,4,...]" ("Sin" #00B050), "Cos [1,3,5,...]" ("Cos" #00B050). 16. ω-selection box: rectangle at x 48-93%, y 56-95%, fill #DAEEF3, 2pt #0070C0 border. 17. Inside it, two selection lines (~14pt, black text with #C00000 tokens): "Use different "ω" values for different "Pairs"" ("ω", "Pairs" red) and "Select "ω" Value Based on "Pair" index "k"" ("ω", "Pair", "k" red). 18. Equation sub-box: white rounded rectangle with #C00000 border on the right side of the blue box, level with the two selection lines, holding the stacked fraction ω_K = 1/10,000^{2k/d} — large #C00000 "ω" (~24pt) with #0000CC subscript "K", black fraction bar, black numerator "1", black denominator "10,000" with #C00000 superscript "2k/d". 19. Below, two value lines: "Largest  "ω" value = 1" ("Largest" #0000CC bold, "ω" #C00000, rest black) with "(Used in First Pair)" in black to its right; "Smallest  "ω" value ≈  1/10000" ("Smallest" #0000CC bold, "ω" #C00000, rest black) with "(Used in Last Pair)" in black to its right. 20. Note block: "Note:" (#0000CC italic underlined); then "ω" Value depends on Embedding Dimension "d" ONLY ("ω" and "d" #C00000, rest black); then "ω" Value does NOT depend on Sequence Length ("ω" #C00000, "NOT" bold, rest black). 21. Proofread every string against verbatim_text — preserve exact capitalization ("Sin(ω₂t)", "ONLY", "NOT"), internal spacing ("Largest  ", "Odd  Index"), and double-quoted variables; do not let autocorrect alter them. Exclude the mouse cursor and the bottom black bar (video artifacts, not slide content).
